name: VideoVault After Effects Extension
releaseNotes:
- Version numbering now stays in sync with the Photoshop and Illustrator extensions (1.x.0 across all three) instead of drifting independently
- No functional changes since 0.1.4: connection status (Ethernet/Wi-Fi, VideoVault Server reachability, Desktop App status), open-file safety checks, and user activity telemetry (using the native Render Queue) are all already in place
